summary: Replicated rotation parameters of a thrown object (how it spins in flight), written by esv::thrown::ThrowAnimationSystem::ProcessApplyRotationParams (Toolkit EoCServer.dll) and copied into ecl::thrown::CurrentRotationComponent on the client. Born live in shove-throw.

fields.name: AngularVelocity
fields.evidence: ProcessThrownRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50, lines 480-552) computes spins (0..3 by the throw displacement's length against three thresholds of the item throw param) * 2*pi / Duration, puts it on the axis and sign the throw param's axis enum selects (cases 1..6), and stores it as the first vec3 of the 0x38-byte rotation parameters that ProcessApplyRotationParams copies into this component. Live (0,-18.8,0) = 3 turns * 2*pi / 1.0 s; (0,-24.2,0) = 3 turns / 0.78 s.

fields.name: StartAngle
fields.evidence: esv::thrown::ThrowAnimationSystem::ProcessThrownRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50, lines 519-522 and 542-552) copies the vec3 at +0x44 of the item throw param into +0xC..+0x17 of the 0x38-byte rotation parameters it stores for this component. That resource is resource::ItemThrowParams: its +0x38/+0x3C/+0x40 are the MaxDistFor{One,Two,Zero}Rotations thresholds and +0x50 the RotationAxis the same function compares and switches on, and +0x44 is Script Extender's StartAngle (gatekit symbols layout ItemThrowParams). Live (0, 0, 1.5708).

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Serializer member 3: 16 bytes at +0x18. Live (0, 0.70, 0, 0.46) - not a unit quaternion, so kept as vec4.

fields.name: field_28
fields.evidence: Serializer member 4: 16 bytes at +0x28. Live equal to field_18. macOS default writes 1.0 (w1) at +0x34 (hint only).

open_questions: Meaning of the four members; whether the 16-byte members are quaternions (live values are not normalised).
Toolkit esv::thrown::ThrowAnimationSystem::ProcessApplyRotationParams writes it; its named locals would name the four members.
